title: Revamped Gold
description: Revamping Gold tools and armour to have more durability and increase the players swiftness !
body:
![Golden Revamp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3137dd90c8e239a7253c6356f1f8a07debd4060e.png)

Golden Revamp improves gold tools and armour to have more durability and increase the player's swiftness.

when a full set of gold armour is equipped, it gives a 20% speed boost, and gold now has increased durability. This is between chainmail and iron armour, which puts it next to copper armour

-Helmet: 121

-chestplate: 176

-leggings: 165

-boots: 146

Golden Tools' durability has been changed from 32 to 72

golden apples are cheaper now, requiring nuggets instead, and enchanted apples are now craftable with gold ingots.
you may think it is overpowering to craft enchanted apples, but I've changed gold ingots to only craft 4 gold nuggets. this means a stack of gold can only make 6 enchanted apples over 32 golden apples.

bells are also craftable now


If you would like to report an issue or request a feature, then comment them here:https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/revamped-gold/
